items.title: Taaruf: qualitative aur quantitative tajziya (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the unnumbered introduction, printed page 323.

blocks.text: Analytical chemistry kimiyai pehchan (characterisation) ki science hai. Kisi compound ki mukammal pehchan mein qualitative aur quantitative dono tajziye shamil hain: qualitative tajziye mein chemist compound mein maujood elements ka pata lagata ya unhen pehchanta hai, jabke quantitative tajziye mein elements ki nisbati miqdarein tay ki jati hain.

blocks.title: Quantitative taayyun ke chaar qadam
blocks.text: Mukammal quantitative taayyun ke aam taur par chaar bare qadam hain: tajziye ke liye namoona (sample) hasil karna; matloob juz ko alag karna; paimaish aur nataij ka hisab; aur tajziye se nateeja akhz karna.
Is chapter mein laboratory mein mashq ke liye kuch bunyadi alag karne ki techniques bayan hain.

blocks.caption: Tajziye ki do qismein
rows: kaun se elements (ya madde) maujood hain?

blocks.prompt: Ek talib-e-ilm safed powder ko flame tests aur precipitation reactions se parakhta hai, phir tole hue namoone ko titrate karta hai. Kaun se hisse qualitative aur kaun se quantitative hain?
blocks.explanation: Flame tests aur precipitation reactions pehchante hain ke powder mein kya hai: qualitative tajziya. Namoona tolna aur titrate karna napta hai ke koi juz kitna maujood hai: quantitative tajziya, jo namoona, alag karna, napna aur nateeja nikalne ke chaar qadmon par chalta hai.

items: Analytical chemistry: qualitative (kya maujood hai) aur quantitative (kitna). Quantitative taayyun: namoona, alag karna, paimaish aur hisab, nateeja.
